name: Eighth Day Kishimoto-kun
source: When Haruki Kishimoto, a seventeen year-old highschooler, one day encounters recent American transfer student, Katie, they form a life-changing friendship, all while they discover the secret eighth day of the week...
translation: 当十七岁的高中生岸本春树有一天遇到了新来的美国转学生凯蒂时，他们建立了一段改变生活的友谊，同时他们发现了一周的第八天的秘密……
